node.name: Database Information
node.rich_text:
DATABASE INFORMATION
Database Name student_information_system
Table Name students
Table Structure
1. student_id Type: VARCHAR(20) Primary Key Required
2. name Type: VARCHAR(100) Required
3. gender Type: VARCHAR(20) Required
4. year_level Type: INT Required
5. program Type: VARCHAR(100) Required
6. contact_number Type: VARCHAR(20) Required
Sample Records The database contains sample student records used for testing the application.
Database Operations The application connects to MySQL and performs: • INSERT – Add student • SELECT – View and search students • UPDATE – Edit student information • DELETE – Remove student
